sara: Heads-up: nightly matmul-quant shows 8% 99p regression on p4d when under sustained small-batch load. logs attached. :frowning:
leo: which kernel variant landed this week? matmul-v3?
sara: yeah matmul-v3, introduced register scheduling tweak.
anya: I ran quick staging repro 10m load7 and saw eviction bursts. looks like KV cache pressure when clocks drop.
leo: okay we should pin night bucket back to v2.14.6 until we confirm thermal behavior.
sara: propose: deploybot pin region:us-west to v2.14.6 (ttl 8h), prepare hotpatch that selects legacy matmul via env flag, run 5% canary with 30m smoke.
leo: agree. gates: 5xx <0.1%, 99p < baseline+12%, eviction-rate <=1.15x. auto-unpin if clear for 1h.
deploy-bot: preflight: runtime-v2.14.7-quant status=unstable (perf-telemetry failing).
anya: I'll monitor and run numeric diff check to ensure no model drift.
sara: ops snippet for rollback in release notes: `deploybot pin --service runtime --version v2.14.6 --scope region:us-west --reason "matmul-thermal-regression"` and `deploybot unpin --service runtime --scope region:us-west` when safe.
leo: tagging infra to annotate the pin: `deploybot annotate --key=pin-reason --value=matmul-thermal`
sara: timeline: pin ASAP, hotpatch PR in 45m, canary in 1h. will update thread. :thumbsup:
